items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: And I worked with Benny, Dave Bailey, Cy Frazier, and Faith So.

ctx.x: Black Happy. And I worked with Benny, Dave Bailey, Cy Frazier, and Faith So. I don't know, I worked with the Grocey, everything they had here. Every drummer had a record. I worked with them.
Who did Dave Bailey play with?
